Download the PRUE deep model for R

Source: R/deep.R
fb_prue_download.Rd

Downloads the Fields of The World PRUE EfficientNet-B3 model trained on CC-BY data (release v3.1), exported to TorchScript so that it runs with the R torch package without Python. The file (about 54 MB) is cached and verified by its MD5 checksum (SHA-256 9bd353b83826e84ab7c55173e9399674c778c729bf25075e2ca2d977ea33e876).

Usage

fb_prue_download(
  dir = tools::R_user_dir("fieldborders", "cache"),
  url = prue_url,
  overwrite = FALSE
)

Arguments

dir

Cache directory.

url

Download address of the TorchScript file (by default the release asset of the package on GitHub).

overwrite

Download again even if a verified copy exists.

Value

Path of the model file.

References

Kerner, H. et al. (2025) Fields of The World: a machine learning benchmark dataset for global agricultural field boundary segmentation. Proceedings of the AAAI Conference on Artificial Intelligence 39, 28151-28159. doi:10.1609/aaai.v39i27.35034

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
# downloads about 54 MB once; later calls return the cached file
f <- fb_prue_download()
f
} # }
